bio: Lars Scharp is known for the MICHELIN-starred Lars Amsterdam, and now also for Cachet, where he is putting his own spin on the brasserie concept. You see the approach reflected in both the timeless interior decor, which is a contemporary take on traditional elegance, and the extensive menu, which caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner. A spicy prawn cocktail and foie gras terrine make an enticing start, followed by succulent poussin with pommes allumettes, and the pavlova provides a memorable finale that will have you planning your next visit. There is also an excellent selection of premium ingredients such as caviar and lobster. This is a lively restaurant where anything goes - and where lovers of good food feel right at home.
